import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a boxplot to compare the price distribution across different sensor types
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', data=df, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Price Distribution of Digital Cameras by Sensor Type', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Price in USD', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

# Create a boxplot to compare the price distribution across different sensor types

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Price Distribution of Digital Cameras by Sensor Type', fontsize=14)
